text: Not all days of the period were checked for thermal detections on the property. While the initial check covered the days from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 for all sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, MODIS), data for the last two days, 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08, were not available due to temporal gaps. Therefore, the assessment for these days is marked as "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE."
